verdict.rationale: Groq maintains a dedicated rate-limits.md page describing how to view exact limits per org, plus service-tiers.md and flex-processing.md docs explaining how limits scale (e.g., 10x higher RPM/TPM for paid flex tier vs on-demand) and batch processing docs noting no impact on standard limits; models.md also lists concrete TPM/RPM numbers for at least one model. missing for 10: a single comprehensive public table of rate limits across all tiers/models rather than requiring login to account settings, and independent developer confirmation that documented limits match real production behavior
